values.note: FAS camping $12/night with a valid fishing license, $18 without (the split is by fishing license, not residency). FWP's 2026 fee table gives $5 / $7.50 for MT residents 62+, disabled or veterans. The page also lists conservation licenses (MT resident $8, senior/youth $4, nonresident $10).

fees.source: https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39753678 (Facilities & Fees: 'FAS Camping With Valid Fishing License 12.0', 'FAS Camping Without Valid Fishing License 18.0') + https://fwp.mt.gov/binaries/content/assets/fwp/fish/fas/2026-fas-fee-table_adopted.pdf (as previously recorded), read 2026-10-22

sites.source: https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39753678 (Restrictions: 'Vehicle Length Trailer Length is 48ft.'), read 2026-10-22

booking.source: https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39753678 (Restrictions: 'Stay Limit Maximum stay of 7 days'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: FWP lists a concrete boat ramp, a toilet (type not stated) and primitive campsites; no drinking water listed. ADA accessibility rated 'Easy'.

facilities.source: https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39753678 (Facilities: 'Campsite', 'Ramp (Concrete)', 'Toilet', 'Primitive Campsite'; ADA Accessibility 'Easy Accessibility'), read 2026-10-22

note: Montana FWP fishing access site (335 acres, ~4,780 ft) on Martinsdale Reservoir with designated primitive camping, 1 mile east of Martinsdale on County Rd (94 Martinsdale Lake Rd). FWP: 'Reservoir is drawn down for irrigation and water levels fluctuate seasonally.' --Claude
summary: FWP FishMT page confirms $12/$18 FAS camping, toilet, concrete ramp, primitive campsites. Added the published 48-ft trailer limit (the note said none was published) and the 7-day stay limit. Year-round season (manual) unchanged. Not stated: site count, toilet type, how sites are taken (derived FCFS left), hookups (derived electric 0 left). Note corrected (trailer limit), drawdown caveat added from the page, restated facilities/FCFS/fees trimmed.
flags: Missing phone: FWP Region 4 Headquarters (Great Falls) 406-454-5840 (https://fwp.mt.gov/aboutfwp/regions/region4); the FishMT page's Contact Information section is empty.
Waterfront re-audit lead: FWP says 'Reservoir is drawn down for irrigation and water levels fluctuate seasonally', so the lakefront shoreline may sit well away from the camp late in the season.
